description: Fetch Spotify's podcast hub page (open.spotify.com/genre/0JQ5DArNBzkmxXHCqFLx2J — reached via 浏览播客 in the homepage sidebar). Returns every shelf on the page with its name, page URL, and item cards (kind podcast/episode/category, id, url, title, subtitle, cover), scrolling internally to trigger lazy-loaded shelves. Verified 2026-08-20: the hub currently renders a single 'Categories' shelf of category cards (no editorial shelves, no language filter in the tested market); the output adapts if more shelves appear. Runs in a browser context; public browsing needs no login. The returned show/episode urls feed spotify/get-podcast and spotify/get-episode; genre urls feed spotify/list-categories and spotify/get-category.
